newsitem.title: USA: US Midco Group Three diesel, gasoline basis firm.
newsitem.headline: US Midco Group Three diesel, gasoline basis firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent low sulphur diesel and unleaded gasoline basis firmed in the Group Three Tuesday on refiner buying and reports of a Gulf Coast refinery upset, traders said.

Citgo was again sighted in the Gulf Coast and Group Three spot markets ahead of news of ongoing maintenance of a crude unit and an upset involving a sulphur recovery unit at Lyondell-Citgo Refining Co's 265,000 barrel per day Houston refinery.
Refinery officials were not immediately available to comment on the outage.
Low sulphur diesel bids firmed to 1.50 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three against NYMEX February heating oil prices that closed down 0.91 cent a gallon on the day.
Group Three unleaded gasoline basis was heard done at 1.45 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in early trade.
Chicago low sulphur diesel firmed to 3.50/3.25 cents a gallon under the print.
Chicago unleaded was bid 1.75 cents a gallon under the print, up modestly on the day, traders said.
High sulphur diesel basis firmed to 7.0 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 4.75 cents under the print in Chicago, traders said.

Some traders were mystified at the firming differentials, which came in the wake of reports the Williams pipeline system feeding into the Group Three market contained a 25-day supply of gasoline and 46-day supply of low-sulphur diesel.
